observe.description: Read context, identify object, authority, provenance, and ambiguity.

thread.description: Map relationships across files, systems, concepts, and versions.

route.description: Choose the correct execution surface for the task.

fork.description: Create a reversible copy or sandbox path before transformation.

act.description: Perform the bounded task and record output/provenance.

validate.description: Compare sources, authority, versions, and status without forcing resolution.

protect.description: Preserve precious, raw, or ambiguous material before indexing or normalization.

log.description: Record action, provenance, status, and next thread.

hold.description: Do not mutate. Surface the missing authority, unresolved ambiguity, or hard stop.

recover.description: Collapse recursion to one object, one relation, one next action.
